name: JournalFit Studio
purpose: Journal discovery and journal-fit decision support using manuscript title, abstract, keywords, research area, and local journal metadata.
positioning: Independent research-support tool. Not an official ranking, indexing, publisher, or acceptance-prediction system.
privacy_model: Local-first workflow. No API keys and no external manuscript transfer by default. Hosted demo users should avoid confidential manuscripts unless the deployment policy explicitly permits it.
